stops.name: Parco naturale di Stupinigi
stops.detail: The natural park of Stupinigi is a protected natural area of the Piedmont Region and occupies an area of 1611.26 hectares in the metropolitan city of Turin. This term means the vast land domain used for hunting that stretched around the Stupinigi Hunting Palace and was expropriated by the Savoy in the 16th century in order to delimite the reserved hunting area, therefore well before the construction of the building that took place in the 18th century.
